claims.text: The hotel is on Vienna's Ringstrasse, adjacent to the Stadtpark.

findings.quote: along the iconic Ringstrasse and adjacent to the Stadtpark
findings.note: Ringstrasse and adjacent to Stadtpark stated

claims.text: The hotel occupies four linked, heritage-protected 19th-century palaces built between 1865 and 1871.

findings.quote: The original building of The Ritz-Carlton, Vienna consists of four historic, now heritage-protected, nineteenth century palaces that have been linked together.
The magnificent buildings were built between 1865 and 1871

claims.text: The lobby is in the building at Schubertring 5, which was originally built as the Adels Casino.

findings.quote: Schubertring 5, the place where the lobby of the Ritz-Carlton, Vienna is found today, was originally built as "Adels Casino" in 1866.
findings.note: lobby at Schubertring 5, originally Adels Casino

claims.text: Dstrikt Steakhouse and the D-bar are located in the historical building.

findings.quote: Today, the meeting area as well as the Dstrikt Steakhouse and the D-bar are located in the historical building.

claims.text: Pastamara - Bar con Cucina is a Sicilian-inspired restaurant led by Chef Ciccio Sultano.

findings.quote: Experience a culinary journey to Sicily by Michelin-starred Chef Ciccio Sultano at this luxury restaurant in Vienna.

claims.text: Atmosphere Rooftop Bar is on the eighth floor and overlooks the city.

findings.quote: Sit back and discover our elegant 8th-floor Atmosphere Rooftop Bar with its magnificent view across the city center.

claims.text: The ANGATI Spa has an indoor pool, steam room and sauna.

findings.quote: Indulge in a revitalizing journey at our spa with indoor pool, steam room, and sauna in Vienna, and enhance your inner strength.
findings.note: ANGATI Spa has indoor pool, steam room, sauna

claims.text: The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.

findings.quote: Five times each day, the Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations.
As a pet-friendly hotel in Vienna, we welcome all members of your family, including the furry ones

claims.text: The Presidential Suite, in the former Palais Gutmann, preserves August Eisenmenger's ceiling fresco The Twelve Months.

findings.quote: One of the most remarkable examples is the ceiling fresco The Twelve Months by Viennese painter August Eisenmenger, located in the former Bel Etage of Palais Gutmann, today part of the Presidential Suite.
findings.note: fresco in Presidential Suite, former Palais Gutmann

claims.text: Guests of the Symphony Suite are offered a VIP visit to general rehearsals of the Wiener Symphoniker, the Vienna Symphony Orchestra.

findings.quote: Experience an exclusive VIP visit to the Vienna Symphony Orchestra's general rehearsals
findings.note: VIP rehearsal visit for Symphony Suite guests

findings.quote: the Wiener Symphoniker, the esteemed and globally renowned orchestra

claims.text: Guests of the Albertina Suite get free admission and skip-the-line tickets to the Albertina Museum.

findings.quote: Your VIP status grants you free admission to the museum, skip-the-line tickets, access to exclusive events, and exhibition openings.

claims.text: A guided Augarten Porcelain Manufactory experience lets guests create their own porcelain piece, followed by afternoon tea.

findings.quote: Step inside the renowned Augarten Porcelain Manufactory and discover a tradition preserved for more than three centuries.
Guided by master artisans, create your own porcelain piece before concluding your journey with an elegant afternoon tea served on Vienna's finest porcelain.
findings.note: create own piece then afternoon tea

claims.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite status does not provide complimentary access.

findings.quote: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.

claims.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service.

findings.quote: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes a formal atmosphere that may not suit all travelers.
